description: A pie chart with each device name drawn outside its slice on a connecting line.
overview: A `PieChart` with a smaller radius to leave room for labels. `chartData` holds one record per device with a `users` count. The `label` callback reads each slice name from `chartConfig`, and `labelLine` draws the connector. Pressing a slice shows a tooltip.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your records and keep `dataKey` and `nameKey` in step with your field names. Add one entry per slice to `chartConfig` with its label and color; the component takes no props.
